newsitem.title: FRANCE: Court awards Jacadi to French businessman.
newsitem.headline: Court awards Jacadi to French businessman.

text.p: A suburban Paris court has awarded children's clothing group Jacadi to French businessman Armand Frydman, French media said on Thursday.
Jacadi has been administered by the court since October 1996 due to bankruptcy. Its sales plunged during hard economic times and after lower priced competitors eroded its market.

Armand Frydman already owns ready-to-wear group Gerard Pasquier, Cafe Legal, Singer France, and three Nouvelles Galeries department stores. He plans to invest 89 million francs in Jacadi, financial daily La Tribune reported.
Jacadi is expected to post a loss of 50 million francs for 1996, the French daily Liberation said.
